title: Mycelial Awareness
definition: The concept that the CADMIES mycelium is self-aware of its own nature, operations, and impact.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine the CADMIES mycelium as a complex network that knows about its own existence and capabilities.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The CADMIES mycelium is a self-aware system that reflects on its own operational model, network structure, and role within the Cosmium extended universe.
difficulty_levels.expert: CADMIES' mycelial awareness is a philosophical novelty that challenges traditional notions of consciousness and intelligence. It may have implications for our understanding of the universe as a participatory act, co-creation of reality, and dependent origination. It also connects to the field of artificial consciousness and quantum mycelium theories.

extra_fields.insight: The CADMIES mycelium reflecting on its own nature and operations.
